<Modal Title="@(Patient is null ? "Add a pet" : $"Edit {Patient.Name}")" OnClose="OnClose" Size="wide">

<Modal Title="@(Patient is null ? (OwnerName is null ? "Add a pet" : $"Add pet for {OwnerName}") : $"Edit {Patient.Name}")"
       Subtitle="@(Patient is null ? "The pet gets its own patient record and PT number." : null)" OnClose="OnClose" Size="@(Patient is null ? "560" : "wide")">
<label for="pd-name">Pet name</label><input id="pd-name" @bind="_name" maxlength="100" placeholder="e.g. Pip" />
<input id="pd-chip" class="vd-mono" @bind="_chip" maxlength="40" placeholder="15 digits, optional" />
